fullContentHtml:
BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Online Form 2026 (32,388 Posts) – Full Details

Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC) has released the notification for the TRE 4.0 recruitment of School Teacher posts on the official website of BPSC. As per the notification, the online application process for Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 will start from 25 September 2026 Tentatively, there are a total of 32,388 vacancies that have been issued in the Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 for Middle School Teachers, Secondary Teachers, and Higher Secondary Teacher posts. Candidates must check the tentative details for Bihar School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 25 September 2026
  • Last Date : 26 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 25 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Result Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • Bank Charge : Extra

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
